items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) will not go on IR; week-to-week after imaging/specialists, out this week vs SEA but aiming return ASAP. Positive after uncertainty.
items.why: Consensus from evals: not IR, short-term
items.implication: Mariota starts; McLaurin still viable but matchup tough
items.opportunity: Backup QB play impacts WAS pass game short-term

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) may miss Sunday vs DAL in Brazil after DNPs; update groups with Nacua/Collins as possible outs.
items.why: Continued absence from practice, hamstring aggravation
items.opportunity: Increased looks for other Ravens pass-catchers

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) DNP for second straight day Thursday; McVay says not making great progress, not long-term but cautious, likely misses Week 3 vs DEN.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs and coach comments on lack of progress
items.opportunity: Davante Adams routes/targets spike sans Nacua

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) DNP second straight day; Rapoport says very much in doubt for Week 3 vs IND, expected out.
items.why: No practice since injury, sources indicate miss
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz 30% routes/28% share last week sans Collins

items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson ran 45 routes on 55 Love dropbacks in first game without Jayden Reed; with Golden 44. Watson+Golden 48% targets so far.
items.implication: Watson locked-in WR1 role with Reed out
items.opportunity: High route/target share continues if Reed misses

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes this season, 6 targets/8% share through 3 games. TPRR 33% with London off, 17% on.
items.why: Low involvement even with Penix; London dominates share
items.implication: Pitts hard to trust as TE1; London the clear alpha
items.opportunity: London high target share with healthy Penix

items.text: 49ers DE Nick Bosa (calf) expected miss few weeks including Sunday vs ARI; leaning against IR due to roster spots.
items.implication: SF defense weakened short-term; boosts opposing offense
items.opportunity: Cardinals pass game upside vs depleted DL

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) on practice field after good MRI; expects to play Monday vs CHI.
Jonathon Brooks expected IR (core); played just 5 games in 3 seasons. Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back, AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 28% target share/30% routes last week sans Collins; IND 4th-most yards to TEs.
items.why: Usage spike + matchup with Collins out
items.opportunity: High target share continues if Collins out

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop 88.5; DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs weak run D, high prop
items.opportunity: Volume and efficiency vs porous front

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble last week; JAX allows only 55 rush ypg/3.2 ypc. Henderson led post-fumble.
items.implication: Sit or flex down; Henderson rising

items.text: Hates Terry McLaurin vs SEA: SEA fewest FP to WRs, 7.9 ypr allowed; WAS lowest implied total 17. Even with Mariota history positive.
items.why: Brutal matchup + low team total with Daniels out
